title: Warm Wholesome Mexican Tortilla Pozole
description: A hearty, comforting Mexican dish featuring soft, herb-infused tortillas, slow-cooked in a flavorful broth with a hint of smokiness.
instructions: Wrap the tortillas in foil and bake for 10-12 minutes, or until soft and pliable.
In a large pot, heat the olive oil over medium heat. Add the diced onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Add the ancho chili peppers and cook, stirring occasionally, for 2-3 minutes, or until fragrant.
Add the chicken broth and water, and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let simmer, covered, for 20-25 minutes, or until the flavors have melded together and the tortillas are cooked through.
Season the broth with salt to taste.
To serve, place a few tortillas in a bowl, ladle the hot broth over them, and garnish with chopped cilantro.
Serve with pita bread on the side, if desired.
